_comment: Voice-over script, per-line direction, and the anchors that tie design time (the animation's own clock) to spoken words. d = design second, l = line index (0-based), w = word index in the line, ref = 'start' (default) or 'end' of that word, o = extra seconds. A line's word-0 anchor also fixes where that line starts; gap is the minimum pause before it.

tts._voice: Darsho - Royal Arabic Fusha (Voice Library) on eleven_v4, chosen by ear from three full read-throughs (Hijazi, Darsho, Ali) that had all passed the transcript and vowel checks.

lines._lead_in: not spoken: previous_text context; without it the voices shortened the long alif of baalighu at the very start

lines.text: فالوطنُ عقيدة، وكرامة، وعِزّة، لا تُساوَم.
lines.plain: فالوطن عقيدة، وكرامة، وعزة، لا تُساوَم.

lines.text: لا تسمحوا لِحاقدٍ أو خائنٍ أن يَنالَ من أمنِكم، أو يُشكِّكَ في ولائِكم.
lines.plain: لا تسمحوا لحاقد أو خائن أن ينال من أمنكم، أو يُشكِّك في ولائكم.

lines.text: المادةُ الرابعةُ والثلاثون: الدِّفاعُ عن العقيدةِ الإسلاميةِ والمجتمعِ والوطنِ واجبٌ على كلِّ مواطن.
lines.plain: المادة الرابعة والثلاثون: الدفاع عن العقيدة الإسلامية، والمجتمع، والوطن، واجب على كل مواطن.

boom.text: massive cinematic deep impact boom with long reverb tail, epic trailer hit, sub bass

riser.text: cinematic tension riser building to a hit, strings and metallic shimmer, short

whoosh.text: short cinematic whoosh transition, airy sweep with soft metallic shimmer

shield.text: magical energy shield impact, crystalline shatter with a deep thud and shimmering tail

swell.text: warm majestic orchestral swell with choir pad, hopeful, rising and blooming

sting.text: triumphant final orchestral sting, big brass and timpani hit with long fading shimmer

music.global: dignified cinematic orchestral underscore with authentic Saudi character: oud, qanun, ney flute, warm strings, soft daf frame drum, restrained brass, Hijaz maqam colour, noble and warm, 80 BPM, instrumental, leaves space for a narrator

sections.name: Awe
sections.style: quiet reverent opening, solo oud over a soft low string pad

sections.name: Resolve
sections.style: warm strings enter with a steady soft daf pulse, proud and noble, gentle swell

sections.name: Defiance
sections.style: lower strings, firm and vigilant but restrained, steady drum pulse, no risers

sections.name: Belonging
sections.style: tender and hopeful, ney melody over warm strings

sections.name: Duty
sections.style: solemn ceremonial brass chorale with soft timpani, dignified and steady

sections.name: Triumph
sections.style: full noble resolution on a warm sustained chord, strings and oud held steady under the narrator's closing line, it does not fade out, rings to the very last second

music.negative: vocals, singing, choir, lyrics, risers, whooshes, sound effects, trailer hits, braams, impacts, electronic, pop, dubstep

_delivery: Presenter read: calm, warm, unhurried, every letter clear. No audio tags. Case endings written where the line runs on, pausal forms at commas and full stops. Without them the models read balaghu (past tense) for the command baalighu, so every take is checked: its transcript must match the script and each vowel in vowel_checks must measure as the written one (formants F1/F2).
_sfx: Off by request: the score carries the scene changes. Set sfx_enabled true to bring the effects back.
